description: The CoupleFlow logo lockup for the intro screen: overlapping glass 'halo' circles + wordmark 'Couple ♥ Flow'. Retires the off-palette pink; all-purple, tokenized.
notes: Pink #ec4899 / rgba(236,72,153,*) is retired. Heart = colors.accent (#c084fc, lightest purple) so it still pops in-palette. Two halo circles overlap ~40px, symbolizing the shared household.
